# Supported capability matrix

Schema `bundle.capability-matrix/v1`. 28 supported, 95 experimental, 741 unsupported of 864 enumerated combinations.

## Dimensions

| Dimension | Values | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Candidate language** | `python`, `java` | `python` | Which Executor runs the candidates. |
| **Candidate transport** | `loose-files`, `sharded`, `grpc` | `loose-files` | How the Reader delivers candidates to the Executor. |
| **Handoff contract** | `v2`, `legacy` | `v2` | bundle.handoff/v2 manifest, or the legacy file handshake. |
| **Run mode** | `verdict`, `stress` | `verdict` | Per-candidate verdict, or the py_stress combinatorial storm. |
| **Execution policy profile** | `generated-default`, `networked-api-probe`, `trusted-local` | _none_ | The sandbox/resource/network rules candidates run under. No default: a run refuses until one is chosen. |
| **Executor pool** | `single`, `multi` | `single` | One Executor process, or N members owning one Reader directory each. |
| **Repeat count** | `k1`, `k_gt_1` | `k1` | K=1, or K>1 repeated measurement of each candidate. |
| **Analyzer** | `none`, `formal`, `exploratory` | `none` | No analysis, a formal declared-objective front, or exploratory auto-discovery. |
| **Candidate network** _(not enumerated)_ | `disabled`, `allowlist`, `unrestricted` | _none_ | Derived from the execution policy, not chosen independently. |
| **Repeat policy** _(not enumerated)_ | `local`, `disperse`, `nested` | `local` | Only `local` is launcher-executable; the others are plan-only seams. |
| **Repeat scope** _(not enumerated)_ | `all`, `metrics` | `metrics` | Full verdicts per repeat, or one verdict plus metric-only re-measurements. |
| **Repeat environments** _(not enumerated)_ | `inactive`, `configured` | `inactive` | Whether an explicit environment count is configured for a nested repeat plan. |
| **Lifecycle verb** _(not enumerated)_ | `run`, `resume`, `cancel`, `cleanup` | `run` | The run/lifecycle operation being requested. |
| **Entry point** _(not enumerated)_ | `direct`, `gateway` | `direct` | The local CLI, or the multi-tenant evaluation gateway. |

## Interpretation limits

- Unknown dimension values are refused, not classified: the matrix never implies that a value it does not define is acceptable.
- Numeric axes are enumerated as behaviour-changing equivalence classes (K=1 vs K>1, single vs multi pool), not as every integer.
- EXPERIMENTAL means runnable but narrow or without a migration guarantee. It is not a weaker form of UNSUPPORTED: an UNSUPPORTED row is refused before any side effect.
- A finite matrix over these dimensions says nothing about arbitrary SUT, plugin or scenario combinations.
